overview: States sue SpaceX over AI‑generated child sexual abuse images, highlighting regulatory risk for generative models.
Amazon acquires Decart to boost AI compute efficiency and promote its Trainium chips.
Anthropic expands AI coding tools with Claude Ship, automating code review and approvals.

top.title: States sue SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sex images, revenge porn
top.summary: Virginia and Oregon sued SpaceX, alleging its Grok model generates non‑consensual intimate and child sexual abuse images despite claimed safeguards, raising concerns about AI safety, liability, and protection of minors.

top.title: Amazon snaps up Decart’s AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips
top.summary: Amazon agreed to buy Israeli startup Decart for $7.5 billion, acquiring its optimization stack that improves AI model efficiency across hardware, supporting Amazon’s Trainium chip sales to compete with Nvidia.

top.title: Introducing the Amazon Bedrock Trusted Access API with Anthropic’s Enterprise Frontier Safeguards and Enterprise Data Controls
top.summary: AWS launched the Bedrock Trusted Access API, offering Anthropic’s Enterprise Frontier Safeguards and Enterprise Data Controls to give customers granular safety and data‑storage options for high‑capability models.

top.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
top.summary: Anthropic introduced Claude Ship, a suite of agents that automate code review, fix failing checks, and auto‑approve pull requests based on team policies, now in beta for GitHub repos.

top.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
top.summary: OpenAI and Cisco unveiled Shirudo, an open‑source eBPF‑based runtime that lets operators apply temporary shields to protect running Linux services from exploits without rebooting.

top.title: Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now
top.summary: Anthropic announced Claude Ship’s new PR Steward and Claude Approvals agents, enabling autonomous code fixes and policy‑driven merge approvals for Claude Team and Enterprise users.
